Body.Content: Azure Operational Insights, now available as part of the Microsoft Operations Management Suite, is an analysis service designed to give IT administrators deep insight into their on-premises and cloud environments. It also allows you to interact with real-time and historical machine data for rapid development of custom insights, while providing Microsoft- and community-developed patterns for data analysis. With Operational Insights, your operations teams can effortlessly collect, store, and analyze log data from virtually any Windows Server or Linux source—regardless of volume, format, or location. Access real-time operational intelligence with improved troubleshooting, operational visibility, and fast search, so you can explore, investigate, and fix incidents quickly. Interact with real-time and historical machine data, including ready-made intelligence packs that guide proactive decision making about configuration, best practices, security, and auditing. This centralized solution reaches beyond Azure to bring unity and flexibility to all the deployments across your data center and clouds—no matter where they are. For more information, please visit the Operational Insights page. For pricing information, please visit the Operational Insights Pricing page.
